content.short: Soren is a Web3 app on TON that blends street fashion culture with gamified digital identities.
content.description: Soren Street Fashion is an innovative application on the TON blockchain that targets the intersection of digital identity, culture, and gaming. It provides users with a unique platform to express their style through exclusive digital fashion assets, which are represented as NFTs. The Soren ecosystem is powered by the $SOR token, rewarding users for their engagement and participation in gamified fashion-related activities within Telegram. Soren aims to create a rewarding social environment for fashion enthusiasts, leveraging the transparency and ownership benefits of Web3 to define the future of digital identity on TON.
content.meta: Define your digital style with Soren Street Fashion on TON. NFTs and street culture on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
